_comment: Single source of truth for the harness's knobs. Read by the Node scripts in scripts/*.mjs and by the Playwright specs in ../e2e/*.ts. It is JSON rather than a shared module because those two run under different loaders: Playwright transpiles .ts through its own pipeline and cannot import an ESM .mjs from this CommonJS package. Every value can be overridden by the matching env var listed below.

_env.JELLYFIN_URL: overrides the whole base URL, default http://127.0.0.1:<port>
